object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a Document Editor, set an object's description, Undo, Redo. Then set a description and then an attribute, and Undo once. Edit a description in the grid, Undo, Redo. Expected: Undo is disabled before any edit; after the edit it reads Undo set description; Undo puts the object file back byte for byte, the window shows the old text, Undo is disabled and Redo reads Redo set description; Redo writes the edited bytes back; with two steps, Undo undoes set attribute and then reads Undo set description; the grid shows the original text after Undo and the new text after Redo.
